F1.text: - F1 (low, nonblocking), openspec/specs/typescript-toolchain/spec.md:19: the explanation groups `node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc` with commands that resolve to the TS6 compatibility compiler. The actual 6.0.2 wrapper has no bin/tsc there; that invocation fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Bare root tsc/npx tsc resolve through @typescript/old to 6.0.3. The sweep records this distinction, and I independently confirmed the missing path and installed wrapper/API versions. The prohibition and required TS7 routing are correct. This wording was copied faithfully from the existing ADDED delta, so it does not block synchronization/archive. A future authorized wording correction should say these invocations either select TS6 or fail, and should not rewrite frozen historical design bytes.
